HOW_TO_READ_THE_VERDICTS.UNPINNED_TEXT: a text write handle with no newline=. Whether its bytes move depends on what is written through it; reported so the class is visible, not counted as a hit.
HOW_TO_READ_THE_VERDICTS.PINNED: newline= is supplied; translation is disabled. Correct by construction.
HOW_TO_READ_THE_VERDICTS.EXEMPT_BINARY: binary mode performs no translation at all.
HOW_TO_READ_THE_VERDICTS.DEPENDS_ON_HANDLE: json.dump with indent into a NAMED handle; the handle is classified at its own open() site rather than guessed here.
HOW_TO_READ_THE_VERDICTS.UNRESOLVED: mode or target not a literal; NOT silently counted as safe.
